description.narrative: The project will conduct a KAP study of awareness of HIV/SRH/GNB prevention before designing of interventions for student led approaches to SRH/HIV prevention which will be reviewed at midterm evaluation to inform re-planning. It is expected that empowered community actors will take accountability of SRH and HIV quality health services to achieve universal health coverage in school and at community level and achieve 95% 95% 95% goals.
